about_the_game:
Frequently reminded about how she was rescued by faeries despite being a human, Eve (renamable MC) has lived all her life repaying the faeries with her servitude — to cook, clean, and care for the heirs of an elite faerie family in the realm. When the family receives their annual invitation to an upcoming masquerade held by the High Court, Eve is surprised to also receive an invitation letter, only to have her dreams crushed by the family’s objections.

Eve refuses to let go of her dreams of romance and dancing amongst the sparkling high court faeries. Her wishes are soon heard by a mysterious flower spirit in the garden and the spirit helps Eve get to the ball.

Believing in the flower spirit, Eve finds herself at the masquerade in a beautiful disguise and is able to put aside her human identity for a magical evening. But her night soon begins to unmask a stunning mystery - one that ties a clandestine prince, a grand magician, and a roguish knight to her destiny through passionate secrets and mysterious letters by moondusk.

There are 3 romanceable love interests in the main story of the game - Prince Kalon, Astromeria, and Llyr
